description: NAP peilmerken vervallen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. This dataset contains data from expired indicators (such as RD coordinates and description of the location) of Rijkswaterstaat. These markers can no longer be found outside. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "NAP hallmarks expired" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
